about: Drops and loot: scene_add_prefab {drop} makes the thing that lies on the ground and gives an item when picked up with F; scene_add_components {loot} makes a chest leave such a drop behind when it is destroyed, holding the items the loot lists. The stage puts the character 0.6 m beside the apple on the right (F: one apple), destroys the chest on the left, puts the character beside what it left (F: two more). Played as written on 2026-10-11: the apples held go 0, 1, 3. Prints: DR_READY, DR_HOLD apples x (every two seconds), DR_BROKEN; the graphs on the character and on the player also listen for the item events (DR_ITEM, DR_ADDED, DR_P_ITEM, DR_P_ADDED), which never arrive there: those events go to the item's own item graph (see examples/potion).
